title: Managed copies and fail-closed persistence
contract: Preserve imported source bytes and malformed stores. Commit validated metadata atomically; identical retries must persist after a failed write.
regression: Invalid manifests can block the entire library; eager cache updates previously suppressed identical retries.
limits: Synthetic failures do not establish power-loss or multi-writer safety.
reviewed: 2026-11-16: source/document inspection; runtime evidence remains in docs/TESTING.md, no fresh app tests for this harness change.

title: Independent snapshots and draft recovery
contract: Only successful saves advance history. Independent snapshots must preserve groups, note attachments and genuine hidden flags. Failed draft saves retain input and block transitions.
regression: Shared PDF dictionaries and renderer-only hidden flags previously dropped or hid restored annotations; detached retries can duplicate notes.
limits: Also inspect disposable cropped/rotated PDFs and export/reopen; tests do not certify arbitrary PDF fidelity.
reviewed: 2026-11-16: source/document inspection; runtime evidence remains in docs/TESTING.md, no fresh app tests for this harness change.

title: PDF + manifest structural transaction
contract: Page count, current page and stars must agree after insert/Undo/Redo. Keep recovery journal until both PDF and manifest are consistent; replace stale AI state.
regression: L1: appended pages could make the manifest invalid on relaunch. Rollback must remain retryable.
limits: Large journals cost memory/disk; disk exhaustion can block restoration. No full power-loss guarantee.
reviewed: 2026-11-16: source/document inspection; runtime evidence remains in docs/TESTING.md, no fresh app tests for this harness change.

title: Document identity, flush gates and cache invalidation
contract: Flush pending edits before navigation/removal/export/quit; abort on failure. Obsolete callbacks/jobs cannot publish or save into another paper/revision. Reset caches on replacement and rollback.
regression: L3: removal stranded writing buffers; rollback creates fresh annotation objects even without a revision increment.
limits: Main-actor PDFKit access is required. Below-page writing buffer is not crash-durable.
reviewed: 2026-11-16: source/document inspection; runtime evidence remains in docs/TESTING.md, no fresh app tests for this harness change.

title: Explicit, bounded, isolated AI requests
contract: Only explicit user actions send bounded text. Preserve provider choice, cancellation, source validation, fingerprint checks and local history; treat all evidence as untrusted.
regression: Broad subprocess access or stale completion can expose unrelated data or overwrite history. Saved history retention (L5) remains an open product decision.
limits: Use injected providers. Live-provider tests are opt-in; no automatic network or credential use for a harness check.
reviewed: 2026-11-16: source/document inspection; runtime evidence remains in docs/TESTING.md, no fresh app tests for this harness change.

title: Noninteractive credentials and isolated environment
contract: Keep process/query Keychain interaction disabled and provider child environments stripped. Resolve only authorized configuration; never print secrets or add key controls without a request.
regression: Legacy Keychain ACL prompts required process-level suppression in addition to query policy; restricted test environments differ from host services.
limits: A policy assertion or build does not prove every live credential path is prompt-free.
reviewed: 2026-11-16: source/document inspection; runtime evidence remains in docs/TESTING.md, no fresh app tests for this harness change.

title: Settled visual requirements
contract: Keep Preview highlight colors yellow/green/blue/pink with opaque sRGB; preserve legacy saved-color recognition. Use the single adaptive Liquid Glass theme with accessibility fallbacks.
regression: Extra compositing changes PDF highlight colors; reintroducing theme variants contradicts settled requirements.
limits: Render tests require AppKit services; inspect light/dark, contrast and narrow layouts for visual changes.
